posts.title: Custom Firmware for the Sony MZ-RH1
posts.description: Custom Firmware for the Sony MZ-RH1 Modern usability improvements for Sony's last Hi-MD flagship recorder. posts.title: Towards Custom Firmware for the MZ-RH1
posts.description: As some of you may know, I’ve been producing new displays for the MZ-RH1, with the goal to revive as many MZ-RH1s as possible.
